findings.where: theories/becoming/results/THEORY-GRAPH.md, 'The five shared laws' table, column 'On the grammar' beside 'Central declarations on it' (tools/research/spine.py shared_laws_section, held[False])
findings.text: "| Widening | ... | its models' laws proved from it | 8 |" and "| Lumping | ... | its models' laws proved from it | 2 |"

Or have the registry print the basis on the edge record's page. Link the JSON where 'the edge record's words' are quoted.

findings.where: THEORY-GRAPH.md, 'Is the foundation circular?' (spine.py circular_paragraph)
findings.text: "no result reaches itself: there is no cycle (computed at each render)"
findings.why: The count is right: 1,162 edges, 479 results, a topological sort reaches all 479. But it is presented as a finding when the registry forces it. registry.py rejects any cycle over all declared dependencies ("{ident}: circular result dependency"), and a self-link too ("missing or self result link"). The checker's own description lists "dependency cycles" and says it does not "compile Lean, prove semantic equivalence". A record set with a cycle could not land, so the render cannot report otherwise. A reader takes as evidence about the foundation what is a landing rule on curated metadata.
findings.fix: Add: "The registry refuses a cycle among a record's declared dependencies (formal-reuse, application, interpretive), so this holds by that check; it says what the records declare, not that the arguments are non-circular."

findings.why: COVERAGE.json names declarations as central and records as stating them: "naming its central core declarations (Lean full names), the records stating them". The 103 records listed do not match the records whose laws name one of the 117. Ten marked ◆ have no central declaration among their laws: additive-part-of-offspring-variance, mutation-and-the-balance-it-sets, the-breeding-value, dependence-formed-from-drawing, groups-formed-by-descent, confined-rise-within-a-whole, selection-with-returns-to-groupmates, fixation-by-drift, fixation-with-selection, coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace. Ten that do state one are unmarked. Three of those are in this page's own 'Stated by' column: necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning, the-split-that-makes-sense, wisdom-root-without-axiom. So the page lists a result as stating a derived central declaration and then does not mark it.
findings.fix: Say what it is: "◆ marks a result listed in a row of the coverage file beside that row's central declarations; ten so listed state none of them, and ten that state one are not listed." Or compute ◆ from the laws and state that rule.
